intent.reader: an engineer who needs to reason about the causal mechanism, e.g. to judge whether the same feedback loop could recur elsewhere
intent.task: understand why the cascade happened in causal order, not just which facts are true
intent.rationale: this case exists to pressure-test relation retention specifically -- a flattened list that keeps every fact but drops the causal chain fails this task even at high fact retention

questions.question: Why was a message queue introduced in front of the enrichment step?
questions.gold_answer: Because the retry-storm feedback loop cascaded out of control under peak traffic, driving that decision.

questions.question: What was the original trigger that led to sender timeouts?
questions.gold_answer: The synchronous handler holding the sender's HTTP connection open for the full duration of a slow downstream enrichment call.

questions.question: Why did retries make the problem worse instead of better?
questions.gold_answer: Because each retry was itself a new synchronous call to the same already-slow endpoint, so retries added load rather than relieving it.

questions.question: Was the feedback loop a problem during ordinary traffic?
questions.gold_answer: No — it stayed small enough to go unnoticed; it only cascaded under peak traffic.

questions.question: After the fix, does a slow downstream call still cause a sender-facing timeout?
questions.gold_answer: No — the receiver acks immediately, decoupling receiver latency from downstream latency, so no timeout (and thus no retry) occurs.

questions.question: Is the retry-storm failure mode merely reduced after the fix, or fully eliminated?
questions.gold_answer: Fully eliminated, not just less frequent.

questions.question: What handles enrichment work now, instead of the receiver doing it inline?
questions.gold_answer: A separate worker process, after the receiver has already acknowledged the sender.

questions.question: Which happens first now when a webhook arrives: the sender acknowledgement or the enrichment processing?
questions.gold_answer: The acknowledgement happens first, immediately; enrichment happens afterward via a worker.
